description: This file contains Swagger API documentation classes for the Fixed Deposit Accounts API in the Fineract project. It defines data transfer objects (DTOs) with Swagger annotations to specify API request and response schemas, including nested classes for detailed responses related to fixed deposit account templates, account details, status, timeline, currency, interest period types, deposit terms, and more.
